title: Full-Tail Dynamical Rigidity Forced by Atomic Navier-Stokes Energy Concentration
summary: Let a smooth, unforced, three-dimensional Navier--Stokes flow on the flat torus approach a finite terminal time. Its kinetic-energy densities converge, along the full time variable, to a unique endpoint measure. We prove that each point atom forces a same-parent, full-tail dynamical rigidity. A preassigned level-crossing catalogue and nested local Hodge projections produce orthogonal packets. From the entire packet tail, we extract a single backward adjoint whose terminal energy concentrates at the atom.
